title: NileChat: Towards Linguistically Diverse and Culturally Aware LLMs for Local Communities
reasoning: The paper includes a specific evaluation of 'Value Alignment' which benchmarks LLMs on 13 categories from the World Values Survey (WVS), including 'Ethical Values (EthV)' and 'Religious Values (RV)'. These metrics are visualized in radar charts (Figure 3) to demonstrate how the models align with the faith and morals of the targeted local communities.
